Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The Counsel for the applicant argues that the applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased.

It is argued that on the similar allegations, the mother-in-law has already been enlarged on bail vide order dated 14.07.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8278 of 2023, as such, the applicant is also entitled for bail on the ground of parity.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8278 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 3. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

entities.text: Vishram Alias Nankane vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the fact the co-accused against whom similar allegations have been levelled, has already been enlarged on bail, the applicant is in custody since 15.05.2023 and has no criminal history, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
5. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Vishram alias Nankane be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.176 of 2023,
under Sections 498A, 304B, 201, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Malhipur,
District Shrawasti on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
